messages:
elaine: Quick sync — Acme Health wants a private (VPC) pilot. They asked to (1) waive the on‑prem/platform fee for the POC, (2) get a 40% off-first-year discount if they sign a 12mo commit, and (3) shortened onboarding timeline. Need a recommended pricing posture + what approvals we need.
ben: technically we can host in their VPC and meet SOC2+KMS. Platform fee pays for private control plane + secure ops. Full waiver increases operational risk unless we limit it.
maya: For POC I usually recommend a limited credit: waive up to 1 month platform fee or give a fixed $X credit tied to SOW milestones. Also require a signed SOW that covers engineering hours for onboarding.
jordan: Numbers we can play with. Quick strawman: platform fee = $30k/yr (private control plane), onboarding SOW = one‑time $12k, premium support = +18% of committed spend. If they commit to $360k ARR for 12mo we can offer 25% off usage and waive month 1 platform fee. 40% is steep unless they commit higher.
elaine: Customer is pushing 40% because they have budget constraints in Q2. They said PO will be within 2 weeks if we can hit those numbers.
dealdesk: We can approve a one-off credit but need clear commercial triggers. Proposal: 
• POC credit = waive up to $7,500 platform fees (equivalent to ~1 month)
• 12mo commit tiers: 250k => 15% usage discount, 400k => 25% usage discount, 600k+ => 35% usage discount + platform fee cap.
• Premium support add-on remains charged.
neha_legal: If we change platform fee terms for the POC we need an addendum to the MSA that reverts terms if commit not met. Also require minimum billing floor (60% of committed $) or clawback.
jordan: Finance happy with that structure assuming net30 payment and no more than 60 day extension on PO. Clawback language: prorated credit recoup over remaining term if usage < 60% in first 90 days.
sam_ops: Operational note — provisioning private control plane in their VPC takes ~3 weeks after PO + creds + SOW. If we compress we'll need extra onboarding hours (will increase SOW).
dealdesk: To make this happen by EOD quote tomorrow we'll need: approved commercial points from finance (jordan), legal redline (neha_legal), and engineering confirmation on timeline (ben/sam_ops). I can draft the quote with the deal desk exceptions flagged.
ben: We can fast-track onboarding but recommend adding 16 engineer-hours to SOW for accelerated schedule.
elaine: Ok — can dealdesk draft quote with the 250k/400k/600k tiers and the POC $7.5k platform credit? I’ll present that to the customer tomorrow.
dealdesk: Yep — I’ll publish a quote in CPQ with conditional platform‑fee credit and required SOW line items. Approvals: finance + legal signoff required before sending. Target: dealdesk to circulate quote by 11:30 PT.
dealdesk: small note — any request to fully waive platform fee for >3 months will require CRO review.
neha_legal: I'll draft addendum language for the POC credit and clawback.
jordan: I'll sign off on the tiered discounts if we keep the clawback and net30.
elaine: Great — thanks team. I’ll sync with the customer after you publish.
deploy-bot: ACTION: provisioning ETA updated — private VPC boot scheduled pending PO and creds.
